song.name: Age of Shadows
song.plot: The Covenant's golden era in Eldoria. Operating from grand estates, the vampires establish blood tithes over human cities, living as secret aristocrats.
song.analysis: The original is a generic "golden era / hidden rulers" piece. The reworked version anchors it to the Covenant's golden age: vampires living as secret aristocrats from grand estates, extracting blood tithes from human cities. "Soul-vaults" ties directly to Acheron's soul-banking. Preserves the 4-verse + bridge structure and strict 7-8 syllable meter. Suggested song direction: regal, decadent, cold — baroque strings, velvet male vocals, slow waltz, dark opulence.
